captions.oneTitlePerPhrase: One title per phrase spoken, cut to the words' own timing, on the first lane with room.

captions.typeWordsPutScreen: Type the words to put on screen…
clipInspector.autoRemovalKeepsWhat: Auto removal keeps what the model finds and drops the rest: a person, or the one thing the picture is of. Custom removal starts from the same mask and takes corrections painted on the monitor: the smart brush keeps the whole thing it touches and the smart eraser removes it, the plain ones do exactly what you paint; Apply ends the painting. Chroma key drops one colour instead; similarity is how far from the colour still counts, softness feathers the edge.
clipInspector.bringsClipBroadcastLevel: Brings the clip to a broadcast level without riding the fader.
clipInspector.chainRunsTopBottom: The chain runs top to bottom — reorder it with the chevrons. The eye bypasses one link without losing the values you dialled into it.
clipInspector.enhanceExplain: Restores and enlarges the picture with the enhance model, into a copy the clip then shows. Tick to start; it runs in the background.
clipInspector.enhanceShowingCopy: Showing the enhanced copy. Untick to show the original again.
clipInspector.enhanceShowingOriginal: Showing the original. Tick to show the enhanced copy again.
clipInspector.exposureStopsRestSigned: Exposure is in stops; the rest is a signed percent of the picture as shot, and zero everywhere is the picture as shot. Double-click a label to put it back; the diamond keys the knob at the playhead.
clipInspector.layerTreatsEverythingUnder: A layer treats everything under it for as long as it runs. Trim it on the timeline to change what it covers.
clipInspector.liftsSpeechOutMix: Lifts speech out of the mix: a little presence, a little control.
clipInspector.nothingFoundKeepPicture: Nothing found to keep here, so the picture shows as shot. Try another subject, or custom removal.
clipInspector.nothingStarredYetHover: Nothing starred yet — hover a tile and press its star.
clipInspector.rateReTimesClip: Rate re-times the clip in place, so the timeline length changes with it. Trim afterwards, not before.
clipInspector.scalePositionFractionsOutp: Scale and position are fractions of the output frame, so a clip keeps its framing if the project is re-sized. The same numbers move with the box on the monitor. Width and height pull one axis beyond the scale; the edge grips on the monitor do the same.
clipInspector.subject: Subject
clipInspector.takesRoomsHissHum: Takes the room's hiss and hum out from under the voice.

settings.aheadOfReleases: This build, {0}, is newer than any release.
settings.deletingClipPullsWhat: On, deleting a clip pulls what follows it on the same track into the gap, and trimming an edge moves the rest of the track with it. Off, a delete leaves a gap and a trim moves only the edge. Shift-Delete closes the gap either way.
settings.fromFlatpak: Installed as a Flatpak: updates come through Flatpak.
settings.installerOpened: The installer for Concat {0} is open. Concat closes now so it can finish.
settings.lineAcrossLanesMarks: The line across the lanes that marks the current time. Pick any colour for it, or the first dot to go back to the theme's own.
settings.localAddressWarning: 127.0.0.1 is this machine only. Any other address is reachable from the network, needs a token, and is still not encrypted.
settings.logLevelHint: What the log records. Normal is enough for most reports; Debug or Everything when a report asks for it, and the file grows faster. CONCAT_LOG in the environment overrides this for one run.
settings.modelsFetchedFirstTime: Models are fetched the first time a feature needs one. This is where the download looks first; every other source is still tried after it.
settings.noReleasesYet: No release from 0.2.5 on is out yet.
settings.notFromPackage: This build was not installed from a package, so there is nothing to put in its place.
settings.offClickRulerPast: Off, a click on the ruler past the last clip lands the playhead there, and a clip placed at the playhead goes with it. On, the playhead never leaves the content.
settings.packageOpened: Concat {0} is downloaded and open in the package installer. Install it there, then start Concat again.
settings.proxiesHint: Off, playback reads your files as they are. On, each video larger than HD gets a smaller copy, made once in the background, for smoother playback at Half and Quarter.
settings.scaleHint: Draw the interface larger than the display's own scale. Most of Concat was built on a small laptop, and reads small on a large screen.
settings.servesConcatApiWhile: Serves the Concat API while the window is open, so a script or another program can create, edit and export projects of its own. Anything that connects can read and write files as you can.
settings.switchVersionNote: Any release from 0.2.5 on can be put in this one's place, newer or older. Earlier releases have no way back up, so they are not offered.
settings.versionInstalled: Concat {0} is installed. Concat starts again now.
settings.whatConnectionMustPresent: What a connection must present before its first call. Left empty, the server makes one up each time it starts and shows it here.
speech.chatterboxHasNoVoice: Chatterbox has no voice of its own. Turn on Use sample voice below, or download Pocket TTS in Settings › Speech to borrow its two recordings.
speech.closestStudioVoiceReads: The closest to a studio voice. Reads at its own pace, in one of Pocket's two recordings or in any sample from the bin, and reads [laugh], [chuckle] and [sigh] as what they say.

speech.speakersBuiltIntoModel: Speakers built into the model, in English and Chinese. Reads at the speed and with the pauses set below.
